# Seedha Hisab

Seedha Hisab is an independent Pakistan calculator website. It publishes free, browser-based calculators with visible formulas, assumptions, applicable periods and source references.

## Primary sections

- /tools — all calculators
- /guides — source-aware calculation guides
- /methodology — calculation and verification methodology
- /sources — source policy and official references
- /editorial-policy — editorial standards
- /corrections-policy — how calculation corrections are handled

## Calculator topics

- Salary and income tax in Pakistan
- Freelancer and service-export withholding
- Filer vs non-filer property withholding
- COD e-commerce profit and RTO costs
- Profit margin and markup
- Marla, kanal, square feet and gaz conversion
- Electricity bill estimation
- Zakat estimation
- Net salary and discount calculations

Important: results are educational estimates, not official assessments or personalised tax, legal or religious advice. Time-sensitive figures should be checked against the source and verification date displayed on each page.
